evidence_status: proposed service-design calendar; no optimal-age result established
age_convention: birthday intervals: start inclusive, end exclusive
original_band_warning: Completed-age reading lasts 24 years because the first band is four years; it is a separate variant.

stages.theme: Persistence, social judgment and dependable practice

adulthood_rule: Use the applicable jurisdiction's actual legal age; stop compulsory program-level developmental tracking and automatic parent/employer access at adulthood. Adult follow-up is separately opt-in, revocable and time-limited.
family_planning: Independent of stage completion, income, tests and sponsors. No universal optimal reproductive age claimed; appropriate education and confidential care subject to local law.
retreat_window_convention: Age labels 27–30 denote an opportunity window; no fixed duration or biological boundary is implied.
retreat_options: Voluntary 2–6-week leave, reduced load, or separately funded 6–12-month retraining/care break. Proposed pilot options, not proven optima; available at other ages too.
